messages:
eva: Quick alert: proposing to unpin runtime 2.14 -> 2.16 for hosted canary at 22:30 UTC tonight. This is to pick up perf micro-optimizations but we saw a regressive tail for quant-heavy workloads in eu-central. Change window 22:30-01:30 UTC. Telemetry link: https://internal.telemetry/1768-quant-tail
sam: Thanks. We should be explicit about rollback gates. Who's owning the rollout ops? @ops-sre?
ops-sre: I'll watch. Rollback triggers: customer_error_rate > 0.008 OR p99_latency increase > 25% sustained 6m. On trigger deploybot will re-pin runtime=2.14 for the canary cohort and page oncall.
tess: Suggestion: do a split cohort by model-tag: route quant-v3 and vimax models to the pinned runtime as fallback while unpinning rest. Also use canary_cohort flag in tracing.
eva: Plan: staged: 22:30 start -> 5% traffic for 15m smoke, 30% for 25m, ramp to 100% at +70m if clear. Release notes draft in /notes/rel-1788231111.
noah: SDK impact: SDK 4.0 clients using 'early-warm' KV cache may observe miss ratio changes. Propose header X-RW-Compat: defer-warm to maintain legacy behavior. Will update SDK changelog.
sam: Ops todo: enable kvcache debug for cohort, set metrics flags: feature.unpin_178823 and trace.unpin_kv. Also ensure trace retention for 2h during window.
deploybot: schedule created by @eva. Job id deploy-178823-01. To abort: `/deploy cancel deploy-178823-01`. Automated rollback policy attached.
ops-sre: Runbook excerpt:
```
# quick rollback
if (cust_error_rate > 0.008) or (p99_now >= p99_baseline * 1.25 for 6m):
  deploybot pin runtime=2.14 cohort=canary
  post to #incidents with summary and link to traces
  escalate to eng-runtime and eng-ml leads
```
tess: QA: I'll run long-sequence synthetic for quant-v3 on llama2-70b at /qa/longseq/1788 and report before the 30% step.
eva: Tagging @support and @product-ops for customer comms prep. We'll have a short status blurb ready.
noah: If rollback happens we can cut SDK 4.0.1 with compatibility header toggle. I can prepare PR now but won't release until window ends or rollback.
sam: Confirming: we will not change any client-facing schema. All changes are runtime/behavioral only.
eva: Everyone please ack if you're on-monitor for the window.
sam: ack
tess: ack
noah: ack
deploybot: automated note: step1 (5%) scheduled at 1788233400, job deploy-178823-01 queued.
